title: My Earth EDM
premise: The supplied English lyrics move from city hustle to touching spring water and grass, then to the discovery that Earth is a living home shared by everyone.
authorship_notes: Author supplied the song lyrics in English and requested a directing project using workflows 04–06.
Story action, staging, design, target durations and coverage are directing proposals for review.
creative_intent: Begin with the pressure of a route everyone has to cross. Bring the audience down to the height of a bare hand and let a small act of care change how the whole square moves.
dramatic_question: Can Mara keep the walking route open and give the spring water back to the planted strip?
goal: Clear the existing garden spillway so the spring feeds the roots beside the crossing.
stakes: If she keeps sweeping the overflow away, people keep dodging it and the garden stays dry.
constraints: Keep the supplied song section order.
Plan generated segments at 15 seconds or less, including handles.
Lyrics only at planning. Sync points depend on the audio master.
assumptions: Mara, Iman and the spring square are original proposals. The basin and garden spillway already exist.
16:9 landscape, no performance lip sync, one continuous morning in the square.
The two seasonal details are associative inserts. The square remains in the same season.
open_questions: What is the final stereo master or arrangement, and where do its section downbeats fall?
Approve the square layout, character silhouettes and contrast between planted strip and pavers before reference-frame production.

scenes.heading: EXT. SPRING SQUARE – MORNING
scenes.purpose: Show the overflow as a small problem Mara can try to solve. Establish the only crossing, the source side and the planted strip.
scenes.location: LOC-001 · South crossing and low basin
scenes.action_summary: Pedestrians pass left to right. Mara sweeps the thin sheet away. It curls back around the broom, and she looks upstream.

entry_state.summary: Both gloves on, broom in Mara’s hands, Iman moving past with tote. Thin overflow crosses the paving.

exit_state.summary: Same overflow returns, broom held still. Mara is looking up and left toward the spring.

continuity.screen_direction: Stay south of basin-to-garden axis. Keep the audience with Mara. The source is heard before its mouth is singled out.

sound_requirements: Continuous plaza traffic and shoe bed.
Water starts off screen. Place its first clear location with Mara’s head turn.

scenes.heading: EXT. SPRING BASIN AND GARDEN EDGE – MORNING
scenes.purpose: Change scale and listening perspective. Show the intact spring and the dry destination before explaining the blockage.
scenes.location: LOC-001 · Basin south lip and garden curb
scenes.time: Same morning · a few steps later
scenes.action_summary: Mara follows the overflow, rests her broom, pockets her right glove and cups the spring water. She touches the grass beyond the outlet.

entry_state.summary: Gloves on, source murmurs, broom carried, runoff toward paving.

exit_state.summary: Broom against basin west wall. Bare right hand wet, left glove on. Grass bed still dry.

continuity.screen_direction: Right hand enters near foreground and touches water once. Keep the spring at frame left in wider shots and the grass right.

sound_requirements: Narrow the traffic bed toward Mara’s listening position.
One clear contact accent on Drop 1, then a held moment.

scenes.heading: EXT. BASIN AND ASSOCIATIVE GRASS DETAILS – MORNING
scenes.purpose: Give the lyric’s seasonal scale an image, then return to evidence of why the garden is dry.
scenes.location: LOC-001 · Basin and garden · associative macro inserts
scenes.time: Present morning framing a seasonal association
scenes.action_summary: Basin ripple leads to two fixed grass views with changed season cues. Return to the actual fork where leaves and twig block the east notch.

entry_state.summary: Wet right hand, dry garden, bypass running south.

exit_state.summary: Same place and costume. Mara can see the wet leaf mat and the twig at the east mouth.

continuity.screen_direction: SH-012 and SH-013 are matched abstract time inserts. SH-014 restores the same morning and frame orientation.

sound_requirements: Bridge both macros with the same water motif.
Reopen the square’s room tone on the return.

scenes.heading: EXT. STONE FORK – MORNING
scenes.purpose: Let a new tactic and help pay off. The viewer must see which object blocks which direction, and where the first water goes.
scenes.location: LOC-001 · Basin, east notch and curb
scenes.action_summary: Mara points out the east notch to Iman. He puts the tote down, lifts the leaves and holds them to the left. Mara frees the twig. Water runs right into the bed.

entry_state.summary: Leaf mat and twig block the east notch. Broom parked. Tote on Iman’s left shoulder.

exit_state.summary: Leaves held to west lip, twig laid beside them. Bare right hand and cuff damp, water entering grass from the west.

continuity.screen_direction: Mara works nearest the south lip. Iman takes the west edge. Match cuts across twig clearance and first movement of water.

sound_requirements: Second drop begins at twig clearance. Use continuous water from the same source.

scenes.heading: EXT. SPRING SQUARE CROSSING – MORNING
scenes.purpose: Show shared care becoming ordinary behavior as the square reopens.
scenes.location: LOC-001 · West lip, south bench and crossing
scenes.action_summary: Iman brings the leaf pan from the bench. Together they clear the lip. Mara retrieves the broom. Iman returns for his tote and takes the dry crossing.

entry_state.summary: Bed receiving water, debris at west lip. Tote and empty leaf pan on bench. Broom parked.

exit_state.summary: Leaves and twig in pan on bench. Mara has broom, Iman has tote. Dry pedestrian line stays south.

continuity.screen_direction: Allow the old overflow sheen to remain. Feet follow the dry route around it. Keep one walker at a time in close coverage.

sound_requirements: Footsteps and soft pan scrape under the breakdown.
Water bed continues without a reset.

scenes.heading: EXT. SPRING SQUARE ABOVE THE CROSSING – MORNING
scenes.purpose: Reveal how a narrow runnel and a human route can occupy one frame. Make flight a feeling of space opening.
scenes.action_summary: People resume crossing. Mara watches the flow. The view rises in stages and holds over the basin, grass and path.

entry_state.summary: Water enters east bed, walkers go left to right on the dry crossing, Mara holds broom.

exit_state.summary: Same layout and flow, seen from above. No growth or change of weather. Cut to credits.

continuity.screen_direction: Rise without yaw. Top view stays north up with grass right and crossing below. The last view can be a held board with subtle water movement.

sound_requirements: Final drop is the widest music moment.
Keep a little water under the last held image.
